# Coucou source reference

Project: https://github.com/jorge123255/coucou

Inspected revision: `1e5180921c1326fc72e41d313e3e2855e9c10162`.

Strata's initial bot-supervision implementation is original code informed by Coucou's activity and urgency patterns. This notice retains the source license for provenance and future source adaptations. No Coucou artwork, character design/animations, icons, sounds, brand names or demo/design media are included. Those assets are excluded by the repository's separate `LICENSE-ASSETS.md` and need separate permission for distribution.
